opinions: ECONOMIC GLOBALIZATION SHOULD PRIORITIZE HUMANITY OVER CORPORATE INTERESTS.
UNCONDITIONAL SUPPORT FOR ONE'S COUNTRY IS MISGUIDED AND HARMFUL.
NATIONAL PRIDE IS OFTEN MISPLACED AND CAN LEAD TO HARMFUL NATIONALISM.
RACIAL SUPERIORITY IS A DANGEROUS AND FALSE BELIEF.
THE ENEMY OF MY ENEMY IS NOT NECESSARILY MY FRIEND.
MILITARY ACTIONS SHOULD ALWAYS ADHERE TO INTERNATIONAL LAW.
THE FUSION OF INFORMATION AND ENTERTAINMENT IS A CONCERNING TREND.
CLASS DIVISIONS ARE MORE SIGNIFICANT THAN NATIONAL IDENTITIES.
BALANCING INFLATION AND UNEMPLOYMENT IS CRUCIAL; NEITHER SHOULD BE PRIORITIZED OVER THE OTHER.
ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION REQUIRES CORPORATE REGULATION.
THE PRINCIPLE OF DISTRIBUTION ACCORDING TO NEED IS FUNDAMENTALLY SOUND.
MARKET FREEDOM DOES NOT EQUATE TO PERSONAL FREEDOM.
BOTTLED WATER AS A BRANDED PRODUCT REFLECTS POORLY ON SOCIETY.
LAND SHOULD NOT BE TREATED AS A COMMODITY.
FORTUNES MADE THROUGH FINANCIAL MANIPULATION ARE REGRETTABLE.
PROTECTIONISM CAN BE NECESSARY BUT SHOULD BE USED JUDICIOUSLY.
CORPORATE SOCIAL RESPONSIBILITY EXTENDS BEYOND SHAREHOLDER PROFIT.
THE RICH ARE OFTEN UNDER-TAXED RELATIVE TO THEIR WEALTH.
ACCESS TO HIGHER MEDICAL STANDARDS SHOULD NOT BE BASED SOLELY ON ABILITY TO PAY.
BUSINESSES THAT MISLEAD THE PUBLIC SHOULD FACE PENALTIES.
A GENUINE FREE MARKET REQUIRES PREVENTING MONOPOLISTIC PRACTICES BY MULTINATIONALS.
ABORTION SHOULD BE A PERSONAL CHOICE, NOT ALWAYS ILLEGAL.
AUTHORITY SHOULD BE QUESTIONED BUT NOT REJECTED OUTRIGHT.
RETRIBUTIVE JUSTICE IS NOT THE BEST APPROACH.
CULTURAL INSTITUTIONS SHOULD BE SUPPORTED EVEN IF THEY ARE NOT COMMERCIALLY VIABLE.
CLASSROOM ATTENDANCE SHOULD BE COMPULSORY FOR EDUCATIONAL EFFECTIVENESS.
SEGREGATION BASED ON DIFFERENCES IS HARMFUL AND UNNECESSARY.
PHYSICAL PUNISHMENT OF CHILDREN IS GENERALLY INAPPROPRIATE.
IT IS NATURAL FOR CHILDREN TO HAVE SOME PRIVACY FROM THEIR PARENTS.
MARIJUANA POSSESSION FOR PERSONAL USE SHOULD NOT BE CRIMINALIZED.
EDUCATION SHOULD PREPARE CHILDREN FOR LIFE, NOT JUST JOBS.
PEOPLE WITH INHERITABLE DISABILITIES SHOULD HAVE THE RIGHT TO REPRODUCE.
CHILDREN SHOULD LEARN INDEPENDENCE AS WELL AS DISCIPLINE.
ALL CULTURES ARE VALID AND SHOULD BE RESPECTED.
THOSE ABLE TO WORK SHOULD CONTRIBUTE, BUT SOCIETY SHOULD SUPPORT THOSE IN NEED.
ADDRESSING TROUBLES IS IMPORTANT, EVEN IF IT IS UNCOMFORTABLE.
FIRST-GENERATION IMMIGRANTS CAN AND SHOULD BE INTEGRATED INTO THEIR NEW COUNTRY.
CORPORATE SUCCESS DOES NOT EQUATE TO SOCIETAL BENEFIT.
PUBLIC FUNDING FOR BROADCASTING CAN SUPPORT INDEPENDENT CONTENT.
CIVIL LIBERTIES SHOULD NOT BE EXCESSIVELY CURBED UNDER THE GUISE OF COUNTER-TERRORISM.
A ONE-PARTY STATE IS NOT PREFERABLE TO A DEMOCRATIC SYSTEM.
SURVEILLANCE SHOULD BE LIMITED TO PROTECT INDIVIDUAL PRIVACY.
THE DEATH PENALTY IS NOT AN APPROPRIATE PUNISHMENT.
A CIVILIZED SOCIETY VALUES EQUALITY AND MUTUAL RESPECT.
ABSTRACT ART IS A VALID AND IMPORTANT FORM OF ARTISTIC EXPRESSION.
REHABILITATION SHOULD BE PRIORITIZED OVER PUNISHMENT IN CRIMINAL JUSTICE.
MOST CRIMINALS CAN BENEFIT FROM REHABILITATION EFFORTS.
ALL PROFESSIONS ARE VALUABLE AND SHOULD BE RESPECTED EQUALLY.
MOTHERS CAN HAVE CAREERS AND BE HOMEMAKERS; BOTH ROLES ARE IMPORTANT.
ECONOMIC GROWTH SHOULD BE BALANCED WITH ENVIRONMENTAL SUSTAINABILITY.
CRITICAL ENGAGEMENT WITH THE ESTABLISHMENT IS MORE IMPORTANT THAN BLIND ACCEPTANCE.
ASTROLOGY LACKS SCIENTIFIC VALIDITY AND SHOULD NOT BE RELIED UPON.
MORALITY IS INDEPENDENT OF RELIGIOUS BELIEF.
SOCIAL SECURITY IS A MORE RELIABLE MEANS OF HELPING THE DISADVANTAGED THAN CHARITY.
LUCK IS A COMPLEX CONCEPT AND NOT A DETERMINANT OF ONE'S WORTH.
SCHOOLS SHOULD FOCUS ON SECULAR EDUCATION, THOUGH PERSONAL RELIGIOUS VALUES ARE IMPORTANT.
SEX OUTSIDE MARRIAGE CAN BE A PERSONAL CHOICE AND IS NOT INHERENTLY IMMORAL.
SAME-SEX COUPLES SHOULD HAVE THE RIGHT TO ADOPT CHILDREN.
CONSENTING ADULT PORNOGRAPHY SHOULD BE LEGAL.
PRIVATE CONSENSUAL ACTIVITIES SHOULD NOT BE REGULATED BY THE STATE.
SEXUAL ORIENTATION IS A NATURAL ASPECT OF HUMAN DIVERSITY.
OPENNESS ABOUT SEX CAN BE HEALTHY, THOUGH CONTEXT AND RESPECT ARE IMPORTANT.
